findings.why_it_matters: A reader or tool parsing the table sees ABS, EXCEPTION-STATEMENT and NATIONAL-OF as column headers rather than list members, and EXCEPTION-LOCATION-N appears as stray text outside the list of new intrinsic functions.
findings.explanation: The list was restructured into a markdown table whose first row (ABS / EXCEPTION-STATEMENT / NATIONAL-OF) is rendered as a header row, and the twelfth entry of column 1, EXCEPTION-LOCATION-N, was detached from the table into a separate indented paragraph. All 34 function names are present, so no name is lost, but the list's structure is altered.
